title: Concept: Splunk HTTP event collector endpoint with a token
description: A Splunk collector URL paired with an HEC token in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: An HEC token is a write credential for the SIEM index, so anyone holding it can inject events, bury a real alert under noise or forge an audit trail entry.
applicability: Deployments that render a Splunk collector URL paired with an HEC token into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: An HEC token is a write credential for the SIEM index, so anyone holding it can inject events, bury a real alert under noise or forge an audit trail entry.
